sentences.zh: 天福四年春正月癸卯，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianfu, on the guimao day of the first month in spring, the Emperor took his seat in the Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; the guard of honor followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the first day of the first month of spring in the fourth year of Tianfu, the emperor took the throne in the Chongyuan Hall to receive the New Year court congratulations, with the guard of honor arrayed according to custom.

sentences.zh: 丙午，召太子太師致仕範延光宴於便殿。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, he summoned Fan Yanguang, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent who had retired from office, and gave him a banquet in the informal hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the emperor summoned Fan Yanguang, the retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, to a banquet in the informal hall.

sentences.zh: 以延光歸命之後，慮懷疑懼，故休假之內，錫以款密。

translations.literal: Because after Yanguang had submitted, he was anxious with suspicion and fear, therefore during his leave of absence the Emperor bestowed intimate attentions upon him.
translations.idiomatic: After Fan Yanguang had surrendered, he was troubled by suspicion and fear; during his leave of absence the emperor therefore treated him with warm and confidential kindness.

sentences.zh: 帝謂之曰：「無忿疾以傷厥神，無憂思以勞厥衷。

translations.literal: The Emperor said to him: "Do not let anger harm your spirit, and do not let worry and brooding weary your heart."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him, "Do not let resentment harm your spirit, and do not let anxiety wear upon your heart."

sentences.zh: 朕方示信於四方，豈食言於汝也。

translations.literal: I am now showing good faith to all quarters; I would never break my word to you.
translations.idiomatic: I am now demonstrating my good faith to the realm; I would never go back on my word to you."

sentences.zh: 」延光俯伏拜謝，其心遂安。

translations.literal: Yanguang prostrated himself and bowed in thanks, and his mind was then at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang prostrated himself and bowed in thanks, and his mind was finally at ease.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以西京副留守龍敏為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, Long Min, Deputy Military Commissioner of the Western Capital, was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Long Min, deputy military commissioner of the Western Capital, was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 戊申，盜發唐閔帝陵。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, robbers broke into the tomb of Emperor Min of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, tomb robbers broke into the mausoleum of Emperor Min of Tang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，朔方軍節度使張希崇卒，贈太師。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Zhang Xichong, Military Governor of the Shuofang Army, died; he was posthumously awarded the title Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Zhang Xichong, military governor of the Shuofang Army, died and was posthumously granted the title Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 以澶州防禦使張從恩為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Zhang Cong'en, Defense Commissioner of Chan Prefecture, was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cong'en, defense commissioner of Chan Prefecture, was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以侍衛步軍都指揮使、寧江軍節度使景延廣為義成軍節度使，以義成軍節度使馮暉為朔方軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, Jing Yanguang, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Foot Soldiers and Military Governor of the Ningjiang Army, was made Military Governor of the Yicheng Army; Feng Hui, Military Governor of the Yicheng Army, was made Military Governor of the Shuofang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Jing Yanguang, commander of the palace guard foot soldiers and military governor of the Ningjiang Army, was transferred to military governor of the Yicheng Army, and Feng Hui, military governor of the Yicheng Army, was appointed military governor of the Shuofang Army.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，左諫議大夫曹國珍上言：「請於內外臣僚之中，選才略之士，聚《唐六典》、前後《會要》、《禮閣新儀》、《大中統類》、律令格式等，精詳纂集，俾無漏落，別為書一部，目為《大晉政統》。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Cao Guozhen, Left Remonstrance Counselor, submitted: "I request that from among civil and military officials at court and in the provinces men of talent and ability be selected to gather the 《Tang Administrative Compendium》, the earlier and later 《Institutional Compendia》, the 《New Ritual Protocols of the Ritual Office》, the 《Comprehensive Categories of the Dazhong Era》, statutes, ordinances, formats, and the like, compile them with care and thoroughness so that nothing is omitted, and produce a separate work entitled 《Comprehensive Institutions of Great Jin》."
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Cao Guozhen, left remonstrance counselor, submitted: "I ask that talented officials be chosen from among court and provincial ranks to assemble the 《Tang Administrative Compendium》, the earlier and later 《Institutional Compendia》, the 《New Ritual Protocols of the Ritual Office》, the 《Comprehensive Categories of the Dazhong Era》, and the statutes, ordinances, and formats, and to compile them carefully so that nothing is left out, producing a separate work to be called 《Comprehensive Institutions of Great Jin》."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 其詳議官，宜差太子少師梁文矩、左散騎常侍張允、大理卿張澄、國子祭酒唐汭、大理少卿高鴻漸、國子司業田敏、禮部郎中呂咸休、司勛員外郎劉濤、刑部員外郎李知損、監察御史郭延升等一十九人充。

translations.literal: For the officials to deliberate in detail, nineteen persons were to be appointed, including Liang Wenju, Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; Zhang Yun, Left Regular Attendant; Zhang Cheng, Chief Judge of the Court of Judicial Review; Tang Rui, Chancellor of the Directorate of Education; Gao Hongjian, Vice Chief Judge of the Court of Judicial Review; Tian Min, Vice Chancellor of the Directorate of Education; Lü Xianxiu, Director of the Ministry of Rites; Liu Tao, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel; Li Zhisun, Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice; and Guo Yansheng, Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteen officials were appointed to deliberate the project in detail, including Liang Wenju, junior preceptor of the heir apparent; Zhang Yun, left regular attendant; Zhang Cheng, chief judge of the Court of Judicial Review; Tang Rui, chancellor of the Directorate of Education; Gao Hongjian, vice chief judge; Tian Min, vice chancellor of the directorate; Lü Xianxiu, director of the Ministry of Rites; Liu Tao and Li Zhisun, vice directors of the ministries of Personnel and Justice; and Guo Yansheng, investigating censor, among others.

sentences.zh: 文矩等咸曰：「改前代禮樂刑憲為《大晉政統》，則《堯典》、《舜典》當以《晉典》革名。

translations.literal: Wenju and the others all said: "If the ritual, music, penal law, and statutes of former dynasties are changed into the 《Comprehensive Institutions of Great Jin》, then the 《Canon of Yao》 and the 《Canon of Shun》 ought to have their names changed to the 《Canon of Jin》."
translations.idiomatic: Wenju and the others all objected: "To recast the ritual, music, penal law, and statutes of former dynasties as the 《Comprehensive Institutions of Great Jin》 would mean that the 《Canon of Yao》 and the 《Canon of Shun》 would have to be renamed the 《Canon of Jin》."

sentences.zh: 」列狀駁之曰：

translations.literal: They submitted a collective memorial in rebuttal, stating:
translations.idiomatic: They submitted a joint memorial in rebuttal, stating:

sentences.zh: 作者之謂聖，述者之謂明，茍非聖明，焉能述作。

translations.literal: "He who creates is called a sage; he who expounds is called enlightened. If one is not sage and enlightened, one cannot compose and expound."
translations.idiomatic: "He who creates is called a sage; he who expounds is called enlightened. Without sage wisdom and clarity, no one could compose and expound."

sentences.zh: 若運因革故，則事乃維新，或改正朔而變犧牲，或易服色而殊徽號。

translations.literal: When the age calls for reform of the old, affairs are then renewed; one may change the calendar and alter sacrificial offerings, or change ceremonial colors and alter titles and insignia.
translations.idiomatic: When the times demand reform of the old, affairs are made new: the calendar may be changed and sacrifices altered, or ceremonial colors and regnal titles may be changed.

sentences.zh: 是以五帝殊時，不相沿樂；

translations.literal: Therefore the Five Emperors lived in different ages and did not inherit one another's music;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Five Emperors lived in different ages and did not inherit one another's music;

sentences.zh: 三王異世，不相襲禮。

translations.literal: the Three Kings lived in different generations and did not inherit one another's rites.
translations.idiomatic: and the Three Kings lived in different generations and did not inherit one another's rites.

sentences.zh: 至於近代，率由舊章；

translations.literal: As for recent times, all have generally followed the old regulations;
translations.idiomatic: In recent times, however, governments have generally followed established regulations;

sentences.zh: 比及前朝，日滋條目。

translations.literal: and by the time of the previous dynasty, entries daily increased.
translations.idiomatic: and by the previous dynasty the number of provisions grew daily.

sentences.zh: 多因行事之失，改為立制之初，或臣奏條章，君行可否，皆表其年月，紀以姓名，聚類分門，成文作則。

translations.literal: Many arose from errors in administration and were changed into the founding of new institutions; or a minister would submit regulations and the ruler would approve or reject them—all marked with year and month, recorded with names, classified by category and divided by section, and formed into written standards.
translations.idiomatic: Many arose from administrative failures and were turned into new institutions; or ministers submitted regulations and the ruler approved or rejected them—all dated, attributed by name, classified by category, and set down as written standards.

sentences.zh: 莫不悉稽前典，垂範後昆，述自聖賢，歷於朝代，得金科玉條之號，設亂言破律之防，守而行之，其來尚矣。

translations.literal: None failed to examine fully the former canons, leave models for later generations, be expounded from the sages, and pass through dynasties; they gained the name of golden statutes and jade provisions, and barriers were set against reckless speech that would break the law; to preserve and implement them has a long history indeed.
translations.idiomatic: All drew fully on earlier canons, set examples for posterity, descended from the sages, and passed through successive dynasties; they were called golden statutes and jade provisions, and safeguards were erected against reckless speech that would violate the law. To preserve and enforce them is an ancient practice indeed.

sentences.zh: 皇帝陛下，運齊七政，歷契千年，爰從創業開基，莫不積功累德。

translations.literal: Your Majesty the Emperor aligns your fortune with the Seven Regulators and your chronology with a thousand years; from the founding of the enterprise and laying of the foundation, nothing has failed to accumulate merit and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's fortune aligns with the seven luminaries and your reign spans the ages; from the founding of the state, every step has accumulated merit and virtue.

sentences.zh: 所宜直筆，具載鴻猷，若備錄前代之編年，目作聖朝之政統，此則是名不正也。

translations.literal: What is fitting is to record directly and set forth fully the great design; if one fully records the annals of former dynasties and titles the work the political institutions of the sacred court, then the name would not be correct.
translations.idiomatic: What is fitting is to record directly the full scope of your great design; to compile the annals of former dynasties and call the work the political institutions of the sacred court would make the title itself improper.

sentences.zh: 夫名不正則言不順，而媚時掠美，非其實矣。

translations.literal: When the name is not correct, speech is not in accord; to flatter the times and seize credit for beauty is not the reality.
translations.idiomatic: When the name is improper, the words do not accord with reality; to flatter the present age and claim undeserved praise would not be truthful.

sentences.zh: 若翦截其辭，此則是文不備也。

translations.literal: If one cuts and trims the text, then the writing would not be complete.
translations.idiomatic: If the text were cut and trimmed, the record would be incomplete.

sentences.zh: 夫文不備則啟爭端，而禮樂刑政，於斯亂矣。

translations.literal: When the writing is not complete, disputes are opened; ritual, music, penal law, and government would then fall into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: An incomplete record invites dispute, and ritual, music, penal law, and government would fall into disorder.

sentences.zh: 若改舊條而為新制，則未審何門可以刊削，何事可以編聯。

translations.literal: If old provisions are changed into new institutions, it is not clear which sections may be cut away and which matters may be compiled and linked.
translations.idiomatic: If old provisions were recast as new institutions, it is unclear which sections could be cut away and which matters could be compiled together.

sentences.zh: 既當革故從新，又須廢彼行此，則未知國朝能守不能守乎？

translations.literal: Since one must reform the old and follow the new, and must also abolish the former and implement this, it is not known whether the present dynasty could uphold it or could not?
translations.idiomatic: Since reform of the old and adoption of the new would require abolishing the former and implementing the latter, it is unknown whether the present dynasty could uphold such a change?

sentences.zh: 臣等同共參詳，未見其可。

translations.literal: We your ministers have jointly deliberated in detail and do not see that it is feasible.
translations.idiomatic: We your ministers have deliberated together and do not see how it can be done.

sentences.zh: 疏奏，嘉之，其事遂寢。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; the Emperor praised it, and the matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the emperor praised it, and the project was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前晉昌軍節度使李周為靜難軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, Li Zhou, former Military Governor of the Jinchang Army, was appointed Military Governor of the Jingnan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Li Zhou, former military governor of the Jinchang Army, was appointed military governor of the Jingnan Army.

sentences.zh: 是日，封皇第十一妹安定郡主為延慶長公主，皇第十二妹廣平郡主為清平長公主。

translations.literal: On that day, the Emperor's eleventh younger sister, Princess of Anding Commandery, was enfeoffed as Princess Chang of Yanqing; the twelfth younger sister, Princess of Guangping Commandery, was enfeoffed as Princess Chang of Qingping.
translations.idiomatic: On that day, the emperor's eleventh younger sister, Princess of Anding Commandery, was ennobled as Princess Chang of Yanqing, and his twelfth younger sister, Princess of Guangping Commandery, as Princess Chang of Qingping.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，改東京玉華殿為永福殿。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the xinmao day, the Yuhua Hall of the Eastern Capital was renamed the Yongfu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinmao day, the Yuhua Hall in the Eastern Capital was renamed the Yongfu Hall.

sentences.zh: 中書上言：「太原潛龍莊望建為慶長宮，使相鄉望改為龍飛鄉，都尉裏望改為神光裏。

translations.literal: The Secretariat submitted: "It is requested that the Qianlong Estate at Taiyuan be established as the Qingchang Palace, that the Xiangwang of the Military Commissioner district be changed to Longfei Township, and that the Liwang of the Commandant district be changed to Shenguang Ward."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat submitted: "We request that the Qianlong Estate at Taiyuan be established as Qingchang Palace, that the Xiangwang district of the military commissioner be renamed Longfei Township, and that the Liwang district of the commandant be renamed Shenguang Ward."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宰臣馮道、左散騎常侍韋勛、禮部員外郎楊昭儉自契丹使回。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, Chief Minister Feng Dao, Left Regular Attendant Wei Xun, and Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites Yang Zhaojian returned from their mission to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Chief Minister Feng Dao, left regular attendant Wei Xun, and vice director of the Ministry of Rites Yang Zhaojian returned from their embassy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 帝慰勞備至，錫賫豐厚。

translations.literal: The Emperor comforted and commended them to the fullest extent and bestowed generous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor comforted and commended them at length and bestowed lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以天和節宴群官於廣政殿，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, on the Tianhe festival the Emperor gave a banquet to the officials in the Guangzheng Hall; gifts were bestowed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the emperor held a banquet for the officials in the Guangzheng Hall on the Tianhe festival, granting gifts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，左僕射劉句、給事中盧重自契丹使回，頒賜器幣如馮道等。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, the guimao day, Left Vice Director Liu Ju and Supervising Secretary Lu Chong returned from their mission to the Khitan; vessels and silks were distributed as rewards, as with Feng Dao and the others.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, left vice director Liu Ju and supervising secretary Lu Chong returned from their embassy to the Khitan and received the same distribution of vessels and silks as Feng Dao and his party.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，回鶻可汗仁美遣使貢方物，中有玉狻猊，實奇貨也。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, the Uyghur qaghan Renmei sent envoys to present local products; among them was a jade suanni, which was truly a rare treasure.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the Uyghur qaghan Renmei sent envoys bearing tribute, including a jade suanni lion—a truly rare treasure.

sentences.zh: 丙午，涇州節度使張萬進卒，贈太師。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, Zhang Wanjin, Military Governor of Jing Prefecture, died; he was posthumously awarded the title Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Zhang Wanjin, military governor of Jing Prefecture, died and was posthumously granted the title Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 己未，皇子開封尹鄭王重貴、歸德軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使劉知遠、忠武軍節度使杜重威，並加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day, the Prince of Zheng Chonggui, Prince of Kaifeng and Administrator of the Kaifeng Prefecture; Liu Zhiyuan, Military Governor of the Guide Army and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot; and Du Chongwei, Military Governor of the Zhongwu Army—all were promoted to Grand Councilor with the Concurrent Signatory of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Prince Chonggui of Zheng, administrator of Kaifeng; Liu Zhiyuan, military governor of the Guide Army and commander of the palace guard horse and foot; and Du Chongwei, military governor of the Zhongwu Army—all were promoted to grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 天平軍節度使趙在禮封衛國公。

translations.literal: Zhao Zaili, Military Governor of the Tianping Army, was enfeoffed as Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zaili, military governor of the Tianping Army, was enfeoffed as Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣內臣趙處比以版詔征華山隱者前右拾遺鄭雲叟、玉笥山道士羅隱之。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, the eunuch Zhao Chubi was dispatched with an edict on board to summon Zheng Yunsou, former Right Reminder and recluse of Mount Hua, and Luo Yinzi, Daoist priest of Mount Yujian.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the eunuch Zhao Chubi was sent with an edict to summon Zheng Yunsou, the former right reminder and recluse of Mount Hua, and Luo Yinzi, a Daoist priest of Mount Yujian.

sentences.zh: 靈州戍將王彥忠據懷遠城作叛，帝遣供奉官齊延祚乘驛而往，彥忠率眾出降，延祚矯制殺之。

translations.literal: Wang Yanzhong, garrison commander of Ling Prefecture, seized Huaiyuan City and rebelled; the Emperor sent the palace attendant Qi Yanzuo post-haste by relay station; Yanzhong led his troops out to surrender, and Yanzuo forged an order and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanzhong, garrison commander at Ling Prefecture, seized Huaiyuan City and rebelled. The emperor sent palace attendant Qi Yanzuo post-haste by relay; Yanzhong led his men out to surrender, but Yanzuo forged an order and had him executed.

sentences.zh: 詔：「齊延祚辜我誓言，擅行屠戮。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Qi Yanzuo has betrayed my sworn pledge and on his own authority carried out slaughter."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Qi Yanzuo has violated my sworn pledge and on his own authority carried out a massacre."

sentences.zh: 彰殺降之罪，隳示信之文。

translations.literal: He has made manifest the crime of killing those who surrendered and has destroyed the text of showing good faith."
translations.idiomatic: He has made manifest the crime of killing those who surrendered and has undermined our pledge of good faith."

sentences.zh: 宜除名決重杖一頓配流。

translations.literal: He should be stripped of his name and office, sentenced to one heavy beating, and banished by assignment.
translations.idiomatic: He is to be stripped of rank, given one heavy beating, and exiled by assignment.

sentences.zh: 王彥忠贈官收葬。

translations.literal: Wang Yanzhong was posthumously granted an office and given burial.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanzhong was posthumously granted an office and given a proper burial.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，封回鶻可汗仁美為奉化可汗。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, the Uyghur qaghan Renmei was enfeoffed as Qaghan of Fenghua.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the Uyghur qaghan Renmei was enfeoffed as Qaghan of Fenghua.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以左龍武統軍皇甫遇為鎮國軍節度使，張彥澤為彰義軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the guihai day, Huangfu Yu, Commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was appointed Military Governor of the Zhenguo Army; Zhang Yanze was appointed Military Governor of the Zhangyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Huangfu Yu, commander of the Left Dragon Martial Army, was appointed military governor of the Zhenguo Army, and Zhang Yanze was appointed military governor of the Zhangyi Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申朔，以河中節度副使薛仁謙為衛尉卿。

translations.literal: In summer, on the first day of the fourth month, the renshen day, Xue Renqian, Deputy Military Governor of Hezhong, was appointed Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the first day of the fourth month, Xue Renqian, deputy military governor of Hezhong, was appointed minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以汝州防禦使宋彥筠為同州節度使；

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Song Yanjun, Defense Commissioner of Ru Prefecture, was appointed Military Governor of Tong Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Song Yanjun, defense commissioner of Ru Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Tong Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 以護聖左右軍都指揮使李懷忠為侍衛親軍馬軍都指揮使，領壽州忠正軍節度使；

translations.literal: Li Huaizhong, Commander-in-Chief of the Left and Right Armies of the Imperial Guard, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Cavalry and concurrently Military Governor of the Zhongzheng Army of Shou Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaizhong, commander of the left and right armies of the Imperial Guard, was appointed commander of the palace guard cavalry and concurrently military governor of the Zhongzheng Army at Shou Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 以奉國左右廂都指揮使郭謹為侍衛親軍步軍都指揮使、夔州寧江軍節度使。

translations.literal: Guo Jin, Commander-in-Chief of the Left and Right Wings of the Fengguo Army, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Foot Soldiers and Military Governor of the Ningjiang Army of Kui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: and Guo Jin, commander of the left and right wings of the Fengguo Army, was appointed commander of the palace guard foot soldiers and military governor of the Ningjiang Army at Kui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔廢長春宮使額。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, an edict abolished the commissioner title of the Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, an edict abolished the Changchun Palace commissioner post.

translations.literal: [Note:
translations.idiomatic: [Note:

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》載原敕云：同州長春宮使額宜停，沿宮職務，委州司制置。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium》 records the original edict: "The Changchun Palace commissioner title at Tong Prefecture should be discontinued; the duties attached to the palace should be arranged by the prefectural office.")]
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium》 records the original edict: "The Changchun Palace commissioner post at Tong Prefecture is to be abolished; duties formerly attached to the palace are to be arranged by the prefectural authorities.")]

sentences.zh: 己卯，改明德殿為滋德殿，宮城南門同名故也。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, the Mingde Hall was renamed the Zide Hall, because it bore the same name as the south gate of the palace city.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the Mingde Hall was renamed the Zide Hall because it shared its name with the south gate of the palace city.

sentences.zh: 以華州節度使劉遂凝為右龍武統軍，以右龍武統軍張廷蘊為絳州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Suining, Military Governor of Hua Prefecture, was appointed Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army; Zhang Tingyun, Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was appointed Prefect of Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Suining, military governor of Hua Prefecture, was appointed commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, and Zhang Tingyun, former commander of that army, was appointed prefect of Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，征前右拾遺鄭雲叟為右諫議大夫，玉笥山道士羅隱之賜號希夷先生。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, the former Right Reminder Zheng Yunsou was summoned and appointed Right Remonstrance Counselor; Luo Yinzi, Daoist priest of Mount Yujian, was granted the style Master Xiyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the former right reminder Zheng Yunsou was summoned as right remonstrance counselor, and Luo Yinzi, Daoist priest of Mount Yujian, was granted the style Master Xiyi.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎崔棁權判太常卿，以端明殿學士、戶部侍郎和凝為翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, Cui Wan, Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy and Vice Minister of War, was appointed acting Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; He Ning, Academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of Revenue, was appointed Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Cui Wan, expositor-in-chief of the Hanlin Academy and vice minister of war, was appointed acting chief minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and He Ning, academician of the Duanming Hall and vice minister of revenue, was appointed expositor-in-chief of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 樞密院學士、尚書倉部郎中司徒詡，樞密院學士、尚書工部郎中顏衎並落職守本官，樞密副使張從恩改宣徽使：初廢樞密院故也。

translations.literal: Situ Xu, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Granary Section of the Ministry of Revenue, and Yan Kan, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Works Section of the Ministry of Works, were both removed from their posts and retained their original offices; Zhang Cong'en, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was changed to Commissioner of the Palace Directorate—because the Bureau of Military Affairs was first abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Situ Xu and Yan Kan, academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were stripped of their concurrent posts and retained their original offices; Zhang Cong'en, vice commissioner of the bureau, was reassigned as commissioner of the Palace Directorate—because the Bureau of Military Affairs had just been abolished.

sentences.zh: 先是，桑維翰免樞密之務，以劉處讓代之，奏議多不稱旨，及處讓丁母憂，遂以密院印付中書，故密院廢焉。

translations.literal: Earlier, Sang Weihan had been relieved of military affairs duties and Liu Churang replaced him; memorials and deliberations often did not accord with the Emperor's intent, and when Churang entered mourning for his mother, the seal of the secret bureau was handed over to the Secretariat; therefore the secret bureau was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Sang Weihan had been relieved of military affairs duties and Liu Churang replaced him, but their memorials often failed to please the emperor. When Churang entered mourning for his mother, the bureau's seal was handed to the Secretariat, and the Bureau of Military Affairs was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以韓昭裔為兵部尚書致仕，馬裔孫為太子賓客致仕，房暠為右驍衛大將軍致仕，皆唐末帝之舊臣也。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, Han Zhaoyi was granted retirement as Minister of War, Ma Yisun as Guest of the Heir Apparent, and Fang Gao as Great General of the Right Xiaowei Guard—all were former ministers of the Last Emperor of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Han Zhaoyi, Ma Yisun, and Fang Gao were granted retirement as minister of war, guest of the heir apparent, and great general of the Right Xiaowei Guard—all former ministers of the last Tang emperor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，升永、嶽二州為團練使額，改湘川縣為全州，從馬希範之奏也。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Yong and Yue prefectures were promoted to regimental training commissioner status; Xiangchuan County was changed to Quan Prefecture—following the memorial of Ma Xifan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Yong and Yue prefectures were elevated to regimental training commissioner status, and Xiangchuan County was renamed Quan Prefecture, at the request of Ma Xifan.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, the renyin day, the Emperor took his seat in the Chongyuan Hall to receive court audience; the guard of honor followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, the emperor took the throne in the Chongyuan Hall to receive court audience, with the guard of honor arrayed according to custom.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以左僕射劉句兼太子太保，封譙國公。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Liu Ju, Left Vice Director, was concurrently appointed Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and enfeoffed as Duke of Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Liu Ju, left vice director, was concurrently appointed grand guardian of the heir apparent and enfeoffed as Duke of Qiao.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，昭順軍節度使姚彥章卒。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, Yao Yanzhang, Military Governor of the Zhaoshun Army, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Yao Yanzhang, military governor of the Zhaoshun Army, died.

sentences.zh: 升靈州方渠鎮為威州，隸於靈武。

translations.literal: Fangqu Garrison of Ling Prefecture was promoted to Wei Prefecture, subordinate to Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: Fangqu Garrison in Ling Prefecture was elevated to Wei Prefecture, subordinate to Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 改舊威州為清邊軍。

translations.literal: The former Wei Prefecture was changed to the Qingbian Army.
translations.idiomatic: The former Wei Prefecture was renamed the Qingbian Army.

sentences.zh: 戊申，湖南節度使馬希範加天策上將軍。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Ma Xifan, Military Governor of Hunan, was promoted to Supreme General of the Tiance Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Ma Xifan, military governor of Hunan, was promoted to supreme general of the Tiance Army.

sentences.zh: 以前邠州節度使安叔千為滄州節度使。

translations.literal: An Shuqian, former Military Governor of Bin Prefecture, was appointed Military Governor of Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An Shuqian, former military governor of Bin Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，虞部郎中楊昭儉可本官知制誥。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Yang Zhaojian, Director of the Parks Section, was approved to retain his original office and serve as drafter of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Yang Zhaojian, director of the parks section, was approved to retain his post and serve as drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，置靜海軍於溫州，從錢元瓘之請也。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, the Jinghai Army was established at Wen Prefecture, following the request of Qian Yuanguan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the Jinghai Army was established at Wen Prefecture at the request of Qian Yuanguan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以侍御史盧價為戶部員外郎、知制誥。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Lu Jia, Attending Censor, was appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Lu Jia, attending censor, was appointed vice director of the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書崔居儉卒。

translations.literal: Cui Jujian, Minister of Revenue, died.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Jujian, minister of revenue, died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔止絕朝臣，不得外州府求覓表狀，奏薦交親。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, an edict forbade court officials to seek from outer prefectures and districts formal recommendations and to memorialize the appointment of relatives and friends.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, an edict forbade court officials to solicit formal recommendations from provincial offices or to memorialize the appointment of relatives and friends.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，升金州為節鎮，以懷德軍為使額。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Jin Prefecture was promoted to a military commission, with the Huaide Army as its designation.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Jin Prefecture was elevated to a military commission under the designation Huaide Army.

sentences.zh: 以齊州防禦使潘環為懷德軍節度使。

translations.literal: Pan Huan, Defense Commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was appointed Military Governor of the Huaide Army.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Huan, defense commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was appointed military governor of the Huaide Army.

sentences.zh: 右諫議大夫致仕鄭雲叟賜號逍遙先生，仍給致仕官俸。

translations.literal: Zheng Yunsou, retired Right Remonstrance Counselor, was granted the style Master Xiaoyao and continued to receive his retirement salary.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yunsou, the retired right remonstrance counselor, was granted the style Master Xiaoyao and continued to receive his retirement stipend.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以刑部尚書姚顗為戶部尚書，以兵部侍郎、權判太常卿事崔棁為尚書左丞，以工部侍郎任贊為兵部侍郎，以禮部尚書李懌為刑部尚書，以左丞盧詹為禮部尚書，以左散騎常侍韋勛為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, Yao Yi, Minister of Justice, was appointed Minister of Revenue; Cui Wan, Vice Minister of War and acting Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Ren Zan, Vice Minister of Works, was appointed Vice Minister of War; Li Yi, Minister of Rites, was appointed Minister of Justice; Lu Zhan, Left Vice Director, was appointed Minister of Rites; and Wei Xun, Left Regular Attendant, was appointed Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, a round of ministerial transfers was made: Yao Yi became minister of revenue; Cui Wan became left vice director of the Department of State Affairs; Ren Zan became vice minister of war; Li Yi became minister of justice; Lu Zhan became minister of rites; and Wei Xun became vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 庚申，廢華清宮為靈泉觀。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, the Huaqing Palace was abolished and made the Lingquan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the Huaqing Palace was abolished and converted into the Lingquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，御史臺奏：「省郎知雜之時，赴臺禮上，軍巡邸吏之輩，咸集公參，赤縣府司，悉呈杖印。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, the Censorate submitted: "When a provincial bureau director served as supervisor of miscellaneous affairs, on attending the censorate for the formal reception, military patrol and station clerks would all gather for public attendance, and the officials of the capital prefecture and districts would all present their staffs and seals."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the Censorate submitted: "When a provincial bureau director served as supervisor of miscellaneous affairs, on attending the censorate for the formal reception, military patrol and station clerks would all gather for public attendance, and the officials of the capital prefecture and districts would all present their staffs and seals."

sentences.zh: 今後年深御史判雜上事，欲依前例。

translations.literal: "Henceforth, when a senior censor adjudicates miscellaneous affairs and presides, we wish to follow the former precedent."
translations.idiomatic: "Henceforth, when a senior censor presides over miscellaneous affairs, we wish to follow the former precedent."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以鎮海軍衙內統軍、上直馬步軍都監、檢校太傅、睦州刺史陸仁章為同平章事，遙領遂州武信軍節度使；

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, Lu Renzhang, Commander of the Inner Army of the Zhenhai Army, Chief Inspector of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot on Upper Duty, Acting Grand Preceptor, and Prefect of Mu Prefecture, was appointed Grand Councilor and held the military governorship of the Wuxin Army of Sui Prefecture in absentia;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Lu Renzhang, commander of the inner army of the Zhenhai Army and prefect of Mu Prefecture, was appointed grand councilor and given nominal military governorship of the Wuxin Army at Sui Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 以鎮海軍興武左右開道都指揮使、明州刺史仰仁銓為檢校太傅、同平章事，領宣州寧國軍節度使，從錢元瓘之請也。

translations.literal: Yang Renquan, Commander-in-Chief of the Left and Right Vanguard Armies of the Xingwu Forces of the Zhenhai Army and Prefect of Ming Prefecture, was appointed Acting Grand Preceptor and Grand Councilor and held the military governorship of the Ningguo Army of Xuan Prefecture—following the request of Qian Yuanguan.
translations.idiomatic: and Yang Renquan, commander of the Zhenhai Army vanguard and prefect of Ming Prefecture, was appointed acting grand preceptor and grand councilor with military governorship of the Ningguo Army at Xuan Prefecture, at Qian Yuanguan's request.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未朔，陳郡民王武穿地得黃金數餅，州牧取而貢之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, the xinwei day, Wang Wu, a commoner of Chen Commandery, dug into the ground and obtained several ingots of gold; the prefect took them and presented them as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, Wang Wu, a commoner of Chen Commandery, unearthed several gold ingots, which the prefect took and presented as tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「宿藏之物，既非符寶，不合入官。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Treasures long buried in the earth, since they are not talismans or imperial regalia, should not be taken into government custody."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Treasure long buried in the earth is not an imperial talisman or regalia and should not be taken into government custody."

sentences.zh: 」命付所獲之家。

translations.literal: He ordered that it be given to the household that had found it.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered it returned to the household that had found it.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，西京大風雨，應天福門屋瓦皆飛，鴟吻俱折。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, in the Western Capital a great wind and rainstorm arose; at the Yingtianfu Gate all the roof tiles flew off and the ridge ornaments were all broken.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, a great storm struck the Western Capital; at the Yingtianfu Gate every roof tile was torn away and the ridge ornaments were broken off.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔禮部貢舉宜權停一年。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, an edict stated that the Ministry of Rites tribute examinations should be provisionally suspended for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, an edict suspended the Ministry of Rites civil service examinations for one year.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, on the first day of the seventh month, the gengzi day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the first day of the seventh month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 西京大水，伊、洛、、澗盡溢，壞天津橋。

translations.literal: In the Western Capital there was a great flood; the Yi, Luo, Chan, and Jian rivers all overflowed, and the Tianjin Bridge was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital suffered a great flood; the Yi, Luo, Chan, and Jian rivers all overflowed and destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以華清宮使李頃為右領軍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Li Qing, Commissioner of the Huaqing Palace, was appointed General-in-Chief of the Right Leading Army Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Li Qing, commissioner of the Huaqing Palace, was appointed general-in-chief of the Right Leading Army Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以定州節度使皇甫遇為潞州節度使、檢校太尉，以潞州節度使侯益為徐州節度使。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Huangfu Yu, Military Governor of Ding Prefecture, was appointed Military Governor of Lu Prefecture and Acting Grand Commandant; Hou Yi, Military Governor of Lu Prefecture, was appointed Military Governor of Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Huangfu Yu, military governor of Ding Prefecture, was transferred to Lu Prefecture as acting grand commandant, and Hou Yi, military governor of Lu Prefecture, was appointed military governor of Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊申，御史中丞薛融等上詳定編敕三百六十八道，分為三十一卷。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Xue Rong, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and others submitted the detailed compilation of three hundred sixty-eight edict articles, divided into thirty-one scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Vice Censor-in-Chief Xue Rong and others submitted a detailed compilation of three hundred sixty-eight edict articles in thirty-one scrolls.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔：「先令天下州郡公私鑄錢，近多鉛錫相兼，缺薄小弱，有違條制。

translations.literal: On that day, an edict stated: "Previously it was ordered that throughout the empire's prefectures and districts both public and private coinage should be cast; recently much of it has been mixed with lead and tin, thin, deficient, small, and weak, in violation of the regulations."
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict declared: "Coinage throughout the empire was formerly permitted in both public and private mints, but recently much of it has been adulterated with lead and tin—thin, light, and substandard—in violation of the regulations."

sentences.zh: 今後私鑄錢下禁依舊法。

translations.literal: Henceforth private coinage is forbidden under the former law."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth private coinage is forbidden under the former law."

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，以太子少師梁文矩為太子太保致仕。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, Liang Wenju, Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, was granted retirement as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Liang Wenju, junior preceptor of the heir apparent, was granted retirement as grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 閏七月庚午朔，百官不入閣，雨沾服故也。

translations.literal: On the first day of the intercalary seventh month, the gengwu day, the hundred officials did not enter the pavilion, because rain had soaked their robes.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary seventh month, the officials did not enter the pavilion because rain had soaked their court robes.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以中書侍郎平章事、集賢殿大學士桑維翰為檢校司空、兼侍中、相州彰德軍節度使，以彰德軍節度使王庭允為義武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, Sang Weihan, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Assembling the Worthy, was appointed Acting Minister of Works, Concurrent Palace Attendant, and Military Governor of the Zhangde Army of Xiang Prefecture; Wang Tingyun, Military Governor of the Zhangde Army, was appointed Military Governor of the Yiwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Sang Weihan, grand councilor and grand academician of the Hall for Assembling the Worthy, was appointed acting minister of works, concurrent palace attendant, and military governor of the Zhangde Army at Xiang Prefecture; Wang Tingyun, military governor of the Zhangde Army, was transferred to military governor of the Yiwu Army.

sentences.zh: 尚書戶部奏：「李自倫義居七世，準敕旌表門閭。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue of the Department of State Affairs submitted: "Li Zilun has lived in righteous communion for seven generations; according to the edict his gate and lane are to be honored with an inscription."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue submitted: "Li Zilun's family has lived together in righteous communion for seven generations; by edict his household gate is to be honored with an inscription."

sentences.zh: 先有鄧州義門王仲昭六代同居，其旌表有廳事步欄，前列屏樹烏頭。

translations.literal: Earlier there was Wang Zhongzhao of the Righteous Gate at Deng Prefecture, six generations dwelling together; his honorary inscription had a hall with a corridor and balustrade, and in front a screen of trees and a crow's-head gate.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wang Zhongzhao of the Righteous Gate at Deng Prefecture, six generations dwelling together, had been honored with a hall, corridor, balustrade, and in front a screen of trees and a crow's-head gate.

sentences.zh: 正門閥閱一丈二尺，二柱相去一丈，柱端安瓦桷墨染，號為烏頭。

translations.literal: The main gate's lintel was one zhang and two chi high; the two pillars stood one zhang apart; tile eaves painted black were set atop the pillars, called a crow's-head gate.
translations.idiomatic: The main gate lintel stood one zhang and two chi high, with pillars one zhang apart and black-painted tile eaves atop them, called a crow's-head gate.

sentences.zh: 築雙闕一丈，在烏頭之南三丈七尺。

translations.literal: A paired gate-tower one zhang high was built three zhang and seven chi south of the crow's-head gate.
translations.idiomatic: A paired gate-tower one zhang high was built three zhang and seven chi south of the crow's-head gate.

sentences.zh: 夾街十有五步，槐柳成列。

translations.literal: Fifteen paces on either side of the street, locust and willow trees were planted in rows.
translations.idiomatic: Locust and willow trees were planted in rows fifteen paces on either side of the street.

sentences.zh: 今舉此為例，則令式不該。

translations.literal: If this is taken as a precedent now, it is not covered by the statutes and formats.
translations.idiomatic: To take this as a precedent now would go beyond what the statutes and formats provide.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「王仲昭正廳烏頭門等制，不載令文，又無敕命，既非故事，難黷大倫，宜從令式，只表門閭。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Wang Zhongzhao's main hall, crow's-head gate, and the like are not recorded in the statutes, nor was there an imperial command; since they are not precedent, they would be hard to reconcile with great propriety. The statutes and formats should be followed, honoring only the gate and lane."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Wang Zhongzhao's main hall, crow's-head gate, and similar features are not recorded in the statutes and were never ordered by imperial command. Since they are not precedent, they cannot be reconciled with proper ritual. Follow the statutes and formats and honor only the household gate."

sentences.zh: 於李自倫所居之前，量地之宜，高其外門，門外安綽楔。

translations.literal: Before Li Zilun's dwelling, according to the suitability of the ground, the outer gate should be raised higher, and a commemorative frame should be set outside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Before Li Zilun's dwelling, the outer gate should be raised according to the site, with a commemorative frame set outside it.

sentences.zh: 門外左右各建一臺，高一丈二尺，廣狹方正，稱臺之形，圬以白泥，四隅漆赤。

translations.literal: On either side outside the gate a platform should be built, one zhang and two chi high, square in breadth and depth to suit the form of a platform, plastered with white clay, with the four corners painted red.
